mappings.note: Part (a) explains a physical property from the matrix, fluid plasma against calcified bone - structure to function. Part (b) asks what ligaments and tendons each do, which is the role outcome. One code per half.

Three separable demands: the voluntary/involuntary line across muscle types (LO-1), the branched uninucleate structure and location of cardiac muscle (C-4.2-LO-2), and why lifelong fatigue-free beating is essential (C-4.2-LO-3).

Dendrite-to-cell-body-to-axon is structure-to-function; the second half asks how that carries messages throughout the nervous system, which is the role of nervous tissue in the animal. The diagram itself maps to nothing in this frame.

Part (b), the joint comparison, is the largest demand (LO-1); part (a) asks what makes up an organ system, a level of organisation (C-4.2-LO-4); part (c) is the protective role of fixed joints. C-5.3-LO-2 is not cited here, unlike the other musculoskeletal item, because this stem never asks how the tissues coordinate to produce movement.

Part (a) is what lateral meristem does (secondary growth, annual rings). Part (b) is reading past climate off those rings, i.e. interpreting a record and drawing inferences from it, which is what C-8.2-LO-2 covers beyond mere tissue knowledge.

Part (a) is the onion root-tip experiment named by LO-6, recalled and explained. The remaining parts assign the bushy regrowth and the stump rings to intercalary and lateral meristem, which is the role outcome.

Coconut husk against fresh vine twig - the sclerenchyma/collenchyma discrimination (LO-1) - plus an explicit why-are-the-cells-dead-and-hard step that runs from lignin deposition to rigidity (C-4.2-LO-2).

Three codes earned: naming the two complex tissues and saying why xylem counts as complex is LO-1; the scenario itself is a failure of water transport with moist soil, which is C3.2; and part (c) asks why xylem is mostly dead cells, a structural point.

Cactus against water lily is one epidermis adapted two ways, so the cuticle-to-water-conservation step leads; C-4.2-LO-3 for the protective role of the epidermis and the function of the stomata the guide points out.

Three abnormal counts each have to be tied to what that blood component does - oxygen carriage, defence, clotting - so the role outcome leads; C-4.2-LO-2 for part (a), which asks the tissue category and the name of its fluid matrix.

Leg fatigue against a tireless heart is the striated/cardiac discrimination (LO-1), set inside a marathon. C-5.3-LO-2 is cited because the item is precisely about muscle behaviour under physical exertion, which is the fitness correlation that outcome names.

Two tissues identified from what they do - skin as barrier, nervous tissue as the rapid-response network - so role leads; C-4.2-LO-2 for the flat, many-layered, tightly packed structure that part (a) also asks for.

Bone, ligament, cartilage and tendon each identified from the function lost in a football injury (role), with C-5.3-LO-2 for the sporting frame and the shock-absorbing cartilage that outcome names explicitly. LO-5 rejected: nothing about recovery technique or medical recommendation is asked, only which tissue is damaged.

Three joint types read off a dance routine (LO-1) inside exactly the context C5.3 names - use of muscles in dance form - hence C-5.3-LO-2. Not C6.1: classical Indian dance is the setting, not a contribution of India to science.

Totipotency applied to mass propagation of a crop is present-day science beyond the textbook tissue content (C7.1); C8.2 for part (b), which asks why the medium needed sugars and hormones rather than pure water - reasoning about the conditions of an investigation.
